title: Winter Solstice Sunrise 10k-ish (about 1.75 - 2 hours)
description:
Leaving Wyche Shelter at 0730 we will head to the Beacon on the ridge and enjoy the Winter solstice sunrise before continuing to End Hill and then looping back along Alice Betteridge walk before going back to the start. This is about 10.5 k and I expect us to be out about 1.75 to 2 hours. We will walk hills and muster as needed to accomodate all.

If you want to leave a car at Clock Tower and do a half way then let me know as we can probably sort a shuttle.

Optional coffee afterwards if anywhere open (I will research and update).
